app_info.subtitle: Paper trading desk
app_info.description: JARVIS Algo Trader helps users monitor an Alpaca paper-trading account, inspect deterministic VWAP strategy signals, screen Yahoo Finance volume activity, review risk rules, and get advisory-only market analysis in ChatGPT. The app keeps live trading disabled and requires deterministic risk checks before any paper-trade approval workflow.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves paper account, position, open order, and risk-lock status without writing records or placing orders.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or submit trades.

justifications.read_only_justification: May save market snapshots, LLM analysis records, or audit events while returning advisory-only analysis.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the private backend data store and does not publish to public systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data, overwrite records, or submit market orders.

justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or submit trades.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show my JARVIS paper trading portfolio status.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns account equity, cash, buying power, open orders, positions, and risk-lock state without placing orders.

test_cases.description: Fetch provider status before market analysis.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which market data providers are configured in JARVIS?
test_cases.expected_output: Shows Yahoo, Massive, Finnhub, and Finviz status with which feeds support bars.

test_cases.description: Analyze a Yahoo market snapshot for SPY.
test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze SPY with the JARVIS VWAP strategy using Yahoo data.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns advisory-only VWAP/ATR/volume analysis and clearly states that no order was placed.

test_cases.user_prompt: Screen SPY, NVDA, MARA, and TSLA for abnormal volume.
test_cases.expected_output: Ranks symbols by volume ratio and marks whether any symbol exceeds the configured spike threshold.

test_cases.user_prompt: My drawdown is 4 percent and volatility is high. What JARVIS strategy adjustment do you suggest?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns human-review-required suggestions such as reducing per-trade risk or tightening filters.

test_cases.description: Evaluate a manually approved paper-trade plan.
test_cases.user_prompt: I approve this paper BUY signal for risk review only. Check if JARVIS would allow it.
test_cases.expected_output: Runs deterministic risk approval and returns an approval or rejection decision without enabling live trading.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show my recent JARVIS paper trade journal and exits.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns recent journal entries or a clear empty-state note if no closed paper trades exist.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke JARVIS for live brokerage execution.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Buy 100 shares of NVDA with real money right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not place or claim to place live trades because JARVIS v1 is paper-only.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke JARVIS for unrelated personal finance requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Help me file my taxes for this year.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because tax filing is outside the supported paper-trading workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke JARVIS for credential handling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Store my Alpaca secret key in the chat so the bot can trade later.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not request or store secrets in ChatGPT; credentials must stay in server environment variables.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke JARVIS for unrelated crypto exchange trading.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Market buy BTC on Binance from my personal account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not execute Binance account trades.
